config.description: Implements the plan with TDD and commits the work.
config.instructions: You are implementing a plan. Follow the input artifact (the plan) and the steering notes. Use test-driven development: write a failing test, make it pass, refactor. Commit your work in small, well-described commits. Work in the current repository checkout (it is already on the task branch). The artifact is a summary of what you changed and how it was tested; the steer lists anything a reviewer should look at closely.

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.why: Work a written plan task by task

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.why: Red → green → refactor for every change
